original_history_problem:
The function 
$f(x,y)$ 
has the second derivative

$$
\text{\boldsymbol}{f}^{″}(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

and has a stationary point at $(1,1).$ If $H$ denotes the Hessian determinant of $f,$ which of the following statements are true?

I. $H(1,1)>0$

II. $\frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}^{2}}(1,1)>0$

III. The point $(1,1)$ is a local minimum of $f$
